scope: Libero tariff for the City of Bern (zones 100/101), for newcomers. Every value has its own source_url. null = not found.

price_change_warning.text: National public-transport prices change on 13 Dec 2026 (SBB already shows new Halbtax prices). On 2026-11-21 mylibero.ch still showed only the current Libero prices; re-check all Libero prices after 13 Dec 2026.

zones.concept: Libero is zone-based. A ticket is valid for any number of trips, in any direction, inside the zones you paid for, until it expires. Zones crossed twice count once. You buy at least 2 and at most 15 zones; 15+ zones = whole Libero area (yellow and blue zones).
zones.zone_colours: Yellow zones: normal Libero tickets. Blue zones overlap with neighbouring tariff networks: Libero tickets are not valid for trips only inside blue zones. Green zones: only Libero season tickets (Abos) are valid, no single tickets or day passes.
zones.bern_city_note: The Libero Abo and Tageskarte for Bern are sold as 'Zonen 100/101' and cost the same as a 1-2 zone ticket; Bernmobil machines have a quick button 'Einzelbillett Zonen 100 101'.
zones.not_valid_on: Single tickets and multi-trip cards are not valid on the Gurtenbahn, Marzilibahn and Matte-Plattform-Lift. Day passes are not valid on the Gurtenbahn (valid on Marzilibahn and Matte lift). Libero tickets are not valid on boats.
zones.beyond_libero: For trips out of the Libero area you need a national point-to-point ticket from the last stop inside your zones.

reduced_fare_means: Reduced price ('ermässigt') applies with a Halbtax, for children aged 6-15 and for dogs.

tickets.notes: Available in Bern. Multi-trip card (6 trips): adult 16.20, reduced 10.80. Not valid on Gurtenbahn, Marzilibahn, Matte lift.
Also available undated; undated tickets must be stamped before the trip.

tickets.validity: Day of validation until 05:00 next morning, unlimited trips
tickets.notes: Worth it from 2 trips a day (Libero). Also available undated (stamp before use).
Card valid 1 year; stamp before each trip. Can be stamped for several people travelling together with the same reduction.
Reduced = young people up to 25th birthday, women from 64, men from 65 (2nd class only). No Halbtax discount on Abos. Worth it from about 3 days a week.

children.junior_karte: Children under 16 travel free with mother/father (Junior-Karte) or with another accompanying person 16+ (Kinder-Mitfahrkarte); cards sold at any sales point. Price of the cards: null (not on source).

apps.name: öV Plus (Bernmobil and regional partners)
apps.payment: Credit/debit cards, TWINT, Reka-Card, Apple Pay, Samsung Pay, Swisscom Pay; Halbtax PLUS credit

where_to_buy.check_in_out_note: Check-in/check-out apps charge the cheapest valid fare at the end of the day; you do not need to know zones. Check in BEFORE the vehicle departs, ideally before boarding: checking in after departure counts as travelling without a ticket.

machines_bernmobil.payment: Swiss francs in coins, all common credit/debit cards (contactless only) and TWINT. No banknotes mentioned.
machines_bernmobil.notes: Staff at the Servicecenter (Bubenbergplatz 5) show you how to use a machine, e.g. at Bern Bahnhof Kante L.

machines_bls.payment: Cashless since the renewal (Dec 2025 to mid-2026): debit/credit cards, Postcard, Reka Card, TWINT, SwissPass Pay, öV voucher, and an anonymous prepaid card.
machines_bls.cash_workaround: Buy the anonymous prepaid card at any BLS sales point and top it up with cash there.

staffed_bernmobil.name: BERNMOBIL Servicecenter Info & Tickets (also lost property)
staffed_bernmobil.opening_hours: Counter Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00, Sat 09:00-17:00, Sun closed; phone Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00. 23 Nov 2026 (Zibelemärit) 09:00-17:00; 24 and 31 Dec 09:00-17:00; closed 25-26 Dec, 1-2 Jan.
staffed_bernmobil.notes: Free passport photo when buying a new Abo. Helps with the öV Plus app and the Libero webshop. Cash acceptance at the counter: null (not stated).

fines.basis: Number of incidents in the last 2 years.

partly_valid_ticket_chf.examples: missing class upgrade, reduced ticket without entitlement (e.g. reduced fare without Halbtax), wrong route

fines.payment_terms: Invoice within 30 days; reminder within 10 days.
fines.reduced_surcharge_if: You show a national ticket valid at least between two stops of the route, or a ticket of this or a neighbouring tariff network valid for part of the route.

reduced_fare_options.name: Halbtax (half-fare card)
reduced_fare_options.notes: Gives the reduced Libero price on single tickets, day passes and multi-trip cards. No discount on Libero Abos. Renews automatically (open-ended contract).

reduced_fare_options.name: Halbtax PLUS
reduced_fare_options.notes: Valid for all Libero tickets except multi-trip cards, multi-day passes and Abos.

reduced_fare_options.name: KulturLegi
reduced_fare_options.notes: The 2025 KulturLegi Kanton Bern flyer lists no public-transport discount. No refugee- or asylum-specific fare found in Bern.

reduced_fare_options.name: IV-Libero Stadt Bern
reduced_fare_options.notes: Reduced Libero Abo for zones 100/101 for residents of the City of Bern who get an IV (disability) pension, or an AHV pension plus supplementary benefits (EL). Price: null (not on source).

reduced_fare_options.name: Libero Schnupperabo (trial pass for new residents)
reduced_fare_options.notes: Some communes give newcomers a 5-day pass for the whole Libero area, plus CHF 20 off a later Libero Abo. Whether Stadt Bern does: null (ask the commune).

reduced_fare_options.name: Commune contribution for IV/EL recipients
reduced_fare_options.notes: Some communes pay part of the Libero Abo; ask your commune.

rules.text: You must have a valid ticket before boarding; for e-tickets and check-in, the purchase must be complete before the vehicle actually departs.
Undated tickets (single, day, multi-trip) must be stamped before the trip.
A lost or broken SwissPass card is replaced for CHF 30 at a sales point with an official ID.
